scope: Anonymized operator-reported context for the historical production reference; not a reproducible training configuration.
platform: Databricks managed Mosaic AI Model Training
training_data: Same underlying merchant dataset as the local study; not a claim of byte-identical split files.

weight_update_method.evidence: Confirmed by the production team; not independently reconstructed from run artifacts.

local_proxies: Separately trained, test-selected rank-8 LoRA adapters for JO and FT provide local serving comparisons; they are not the production weights.
interpretation: Models, prompts, training recipes and deployment differ. The comparison does not isolate full fine-tuning versus LoRA or establish compute or monetary savings. The platform name alone does not identify an exact historical API.

production_error_observation.observation: Digits can be ambiguous between a store identifier within a merchant name and a ZIP code.
production_error_observation.scope: Reported operational experience motivating case review; not a demonstrated cause of the measured digit-only losses or evidence that labels are incorrect.

manuscript_statement: Operator-reported training time was under one hour for full fine-tuning of Llama 3.1 8B through Databricks' managed Mosaic service. The service did not expose GPU type or count to the team; exact runtime and detailed training settings remain unavailable.
